hypothesis: Two-link structural binding learning must outperform/retain equivalently trained competitors on actual same-native-work while fitting and scoring within equal complete process CPU/RSS; independently trained exact-symbol versus original CB Hamming bit loss.

trained_control.name: CC fully trained two-link exact-symbol competitor
trained_control.architecture: Exactly the same 32-bit reversible two-optional-output-XOR causal binding grammar as CB, four 4-bit variables, 24 permutations, three odd gains of 3 variable bits, one fixed gain, four 4-bit biases, and two learned independent links. CC optimizes FULL-NIBBLE exact mismatch counts on 40 FIT rather than CB's bit-level Hamming; no CB.learn call, no learned CB weights or labels. Can use original CB pure pack/forward/inverse only.
trained_control.search: Factorized 6560 residual scans and 6560 exact-symbol score observations, 96 global layout evaluations; pick unique lowest mismatch; ties/slot-ambiguity abstain. Freeze confidence thresholds 6 FIT bit errors, 2 CHECK bit errors, CHECK veto only and never alters loss/selection.
trained_control.data_access: Only same 40 public FIT + 8 CHECK, no source grammar/labels/seed/oracle or graph outcomes; 32 persisted bits exactly, all training scratch and time accounted; 7 active/9 retained unchanged.

source_generation: Distinct from consumed CB/CA/BY and all old scientific cases. Build 48 unique x and observed f(x), low-bit FIT noise at precisely six indices (1,5,12,19,24,35), not CHECK; 8/9 hop causal-positive + inventory/topology-matched wrong predecessor with 9 off-path distractors. No old 731011/731012 source reuse. Private symbolic oracle only generator verification.
same_native_work: Every naturally eligible trained arm's genuine native scoring must execute EXACT same graph/inputs and full unchanged score/raw/ratio/work as CB for both positive and hard negative. If abstains, document INELIGIBLE; never force scoring, never compare CPU or RSS as same work. Whole-science full-arm eligibility requires ALL original AZ/BQ/BX/BZ/CA/CB/CC to match, otherwise scientific gate fails.
resource: Two fixed nonregistered sources ×7 arms AZ/BQ/BX/BZ/CA/CB/CC ×5 fresh whole-child Linux process samples =70, plus original 14 natural native preflights. Count process CPU via wait4 and OS peak RSS, include interpreter, imports, full 40 FIT, 8 CHECK, fit temporary training, inference and actual 2 native calls when naturally eligible. CB candidate median CPU/RSS median+max <= EACH eligible fully trained same-native-work competitor including CC; CC separate comparison train cost counted. No favorable case removal; one ineligible/failure blocks complete admission.
success_criterion: CC learns both structural links and one-link retention from FIT without labels, CHECK veto only, authentic same native work as CB on both, zero hard false positives, baseline-positive preservation. CB nonregression against CC and strongest other eligible trained arm by whole CPU and median/max RSS; if any condition fails record negative rather than retune.
firstuse: Exactly one evidence-producing GitHub run for these two new engineering source-neutral cases after all protocol and code frozen; subsequent custody read-only. Do not reuse CB-ENG-01/02, BY, CA, BX/BU or scientific BQ/BM/BN/BO/BP/original 192 TRAIN.
acceptance: Even successful engineering source-neutral results do not prove independent transfer; independent signed novel source origins and protected prospective replication under F124-BV still required. Use no paid inference, new controller, unsupervised evidence-to-policy auto-promotion or extra review infrastructure.
